name: Spirit Of Distraction
overview: The Spirit of Distraction in Scripture reveals the tension between God's striving Spirit and human flesh, as seen in Genesis 6:3 where God's Spirit will not always contend with man. Believers are called to focus their souls on blessing the Lord (Psalms 103:1) and recognize that their very existence is sustained by Him (Acts 17:28). Therefore, the appropriate response is to present ourselves as living sacrifices, wholly devoted and acceptable to God (Romans 12:1), guarding against distractions that pull us away from this dedicated service.
